mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are looking at 63 degrees with overcast skies near Harriet Park. The Waxing Gibbous moon is present, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City officials announced that road maintenance, specifically crack filling, will begin on September 28 across five designated areas including streets like Legion and North Jefferson. Also, the Plan Commission is set to review various development projects on October 5.

We have plenty going on, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus pizza night at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead to September 25, the Verona Fall Fest kicks off at Hometown USA Festival Park.
In a noteworthy call from September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I after crashing his vehicle in the 700 block of Shooting Star Road.
Currently, the Culver's in Verona is closed for a scheduled remodel, so no flavor of the day is available at this time.
